verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a developer platform with a CLI and dashboard, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for the Supabase CLI, dashboard, or hosted platform. Self-hosting and region selection are adjacent deployment and data-residency features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
